baslik: The Lightning Strike That Ignited a Fuel Tank

sahneler.metin: Holding near a thunderstorm, a Boeing 707 was struck by lightning.
A wing exploded, and all eighty one aboard were killed.
Planes are hit by lightning often and usually survive.
This strike reached fuel vapour in a reserve tank.
The vapour ignited and blew the tank apart.
Investigators studied how fuel vents and tanks handle lightning.
Lightning protection rules for fuel systems were tightened.

aciklama:
Pan Am 214 exploded in flight near Elkton, Maryland. The cause: lightning igniting fuel vapour in a reserve wing tank.
